人教版必修第一册 第二章第一节「钠及其化合物」（侯氏制碱作情境素材 · 课标 p: PEP Chemistry Required Book 1 · Ch. 2 Sec. 1 "Sodium and Its Compounds" (Hou's process as context material · curriculum standard p.26, China's achievements in chemical science and technology)
怎样用食盐和氨造出纯碱，还顺手拿到氮肥？: How do you make soda ash from salt and ammonia, and get a nitrogen fertilizer along the way?
先通 NH₃ → 溶液显碱性，才吸得住 CO₂: NH₃ first → the solution turns basic, so it can absorb CO₂
NaHCO₃ 过饱和 → 从溶液里析出: NaHCO₃ supersaturates → precipitates out of solution
过滤把重碱与母液分成两路: Filtration splits crude bicarbonate and mother liquor into two streams
CO₂ 回碳化 + 母液析出 NH₄Cl: CO₂ back to carbonation + NH₄Cl precipitated from mother liquor
全对！顺序、过饱和、分解、循环四条线你都理顺了。: All correct! You've sorted out the four threads: order, supersaturation, decomposition and recycling.
建议回看主线：先氨后碳 → 过饱和析出 → 过滤 → 煅烧 → 母液与 CO₂: Suggested review of the main thread: ammonia before CO₂ → supersaturated precipitation → filtration → calcination → recycling of mother liquor and CO₂.
氨化塔 · 盐水吸饱 NH₃: Ammoniation tower · brine saturated with NH₃
碳化塔 · CO₂ 逆流，NaHCO₃ 析出: Carbonation tower · CO₂ counterflow, NaHCO₃ precipitates
滤碱机 · 晶浆分成重碱与母液: Bicarbonate filter · slurry split into crude bicarbonate and mother liquor
冷析结晶器 · 加盐降温捞 NH₄Cl: Cooling crystallizer · add salt and cool to recover NH₄Cl
没有 NH₃：溶液不显碱性，CO₂ 吸收不住，析出率只剩 2 %: No NH₃: the solution isn't basic, CO₂ isn't retained, and the precipitation rate falls to 2 %
母液加盐 + 降温 → NH₄Cl 析出: Mother liquor + salt + cooling → NH₄Cl precipitates
食盐、氨和 CO₂ 进去，纯碱怎么出来的？: Salt, ammonia and CO₂ go in: how does soda ash come out?
参考工况：纯碱产量 24.0 t/h，析出率 32.6 %，分解率 100 %，: Reference case: soda ash output 24.0 t/h, precipitation rate 32.6 %, decomposition 100 %, crystallization 44.0 %; material flows from the salt dissolver all the way to the soda ash silo
前段：化盐 + 吸氨 + 碳化，生成 NaHCO₃ 并析出；后段：过滤、煅烧得纯: Front end: dissolve salt + absorb ammonia + carbonate, forming and precipitating NaHCO₃; back end: filter and calcine for soda ash, then recover NH₄Cl from the mother liquor.
五个工段各解决一个问题：通气顺序、过饱和析出、固液分离、受热分解、母液与 CO₂: Each of the five sections solves one problem: gas order, supersaturated precipitation, solid–liquid separation, thermal decomposition, recovery of mother liquor and CO₂.
侯氏法比氨碱法少了石灰窑与蒸氨塔，副产可作氮肥的 NH₄Cl，食盐利用率大大提高: Compared with the ammonia-soda (Solvay) process, Hou's process drops the lime kiln and ammonia still, yields NH₄Cl usable as nitrogen fertilizer, and greatly improves salt utilization.
去掉这五段里的任何一段，纯碱就出不来，或者纯度、成本不达标。: Remove any one of these five sections and either no soda ash comes out, or purity or cost misses the mark.
常考「联合制碱的『联合』指什么」：把合成氨副产的 CO₂ 用到制碱上，母液里的: Often tested "what does 'combined' in combined soda production mean": CO₂ from ammonia synthesis is used for soda, and NH₄Cl from the mother liquor becomes nitrogen fertilizer.
盐 + 氨 + CO₂ 在溶液里生成 NaHCO₃ 析出，煅烧得纯碱；母液加盐降: Salt + ammonia + CO₂ form NaHCO₃ in solution, which precipitates and is calcined to soda ash; adding salt to the mother liquor and cooling also recovers NH₄Cl, which is how Hou's process eliminated the lime kiln and ammonia still of the ammonia-soda process.
为什么非要先把盐水变成氨盐水？: Why must the brine be turned into ammoniated brine first?
把「吸氨」开关关掉，看塔内和读数怎么变: Turn off the "Ammonia absorption" switch and watch how the tower and readings change
析出率 32.6 % → 2.0 %，产量 24.0 → 0.1 t/h（未取整: Precipitation rate 32.6 % → 2.0 %, output 24.0 → 0.1 t/h (0.14 unrounded): crystals in the tower barely grow and the material flow thins out
碱性溶液才吸得住大量 CO₂；没有 NH₃ 析出率只剩 2 %（课件设定）: Only a basic solution can absorb a lot of CO₂; without NH₃ the precipitation rate is only 2 % (lesson setting)
NH₃ 极易溶于水，氨水显碱性，CO₂ 被大量吸收并以 HCO₃⁻ 的形式存在。: NH₃ is very soluble in water and ammonia water is basic, so CO₂ is absorbed in large amounts and exists as HCO₃⁻.
先通 CO₂ 则溶液偏酸，HCO₃⁻ 远远不够，大量 CO₂ 随尾气跑掉。: With CO₂ first the solution is acidic, HCO₃⁻ falls far short, and a lot of CO₂ escapes with the tail gas.
本课只演示「吸氨中断」这一种情形（模型没有气体累计量与顺序状态），不与「先通 C: This lesson only demonstrates "ammonia absorption interrupted" (the model has no cumulative gas amounts or order state), which isn't the same as "CO₂ first, NH₃ added later".
去掉吸氨：产量 24.0 → 0.1 t/h（未取整 0.14），只剩残余生产。: Remove ammonia absorption: output 24.0 → 0.1 t/h (0.14 unrounded), only residual production left.
常考「为什么先通 NH₃ 再通 CO₂」：氨水呈碱性，CO₂ 吸收量大增并以 H: Often tested "why NH₃ before CO₂": ammonia water is basic, so CO₂ absorption increases greatly and it exists as HCO₃⁻.
NH₃ 让溶液显碱性，CO₂ 才被大量吸收、以 HCO₃⁻ 存在；没有氨，过饱和: NH₃ makes the solution basic so CO₂ is absorbed in large amounts as HCO₃⁻; without ammonia the supersaturation can't build and almost nothing precipitates.
生成的 NaHCO₃ 为什么会自己从溶液里掉出来？: Why does the NaHCO₃ formed drop out of solution on its own?
转动视角，看塔板、自下而上的 CO₂ 气泡柱和塔底晶浆；同时看曲线图上 20 ℃: Rotate the view to see the trays, the CO₂ bubble column rising from the bottom and the slurry at the base; also look at the 20 ℃ point on the chart
曲线游标停在 20 ℃：NaHCO₃ 9.6，NH₄HCO₃ 21.7、NaCl: The cursor sits at 20 ℃: NaHCO₃ 9.6, NH₄HCO₃ 21.7, NaCl 35.9, NH₄Cl 37.2; NaHCO₃ is the lowest of the four; crystals in the slurry at the bottom of the tower are growing
判据：NaHCO₃ 达到过饱和（溶解度排序只作定性参考）: Criterion: NaHCO₃ reaches supersaturation (the solubility ranking is only a qualitative guide)
20 ℃ 时 NaHCO₃ 的溶解度 9.6 g/100 g 水，是四种物质里最: At 20 ℃ the solubility of NaHCO₃ is 9.6 g/100 g water, the lowest of the four substances (NH₄HCO₃ 21.7, NaCl 35.9, NH₄Cl 37.2).
真正决定析出的是过饱和：氨盐水里生成的 NaHCO₃ 超过了它的溶解度上限，才以: What really decides precipitation is supersaturation: the NaHCO₃ formed in the ammoniated brine exceeds its solubility limit and comes out as crystals.
「溶解度最小」只说明它最容易先走到那一步，是定性参考，不是充分条件。: "Lowest solubility" only means it gets there first; it's a qualitative guide, not a sufficient condition.
不做这一步：学生会把「溶解度排序 = 析出判据」当成结论——旧版这条主线改了 5: Skip this step and students conclude "solubility ranking = precipitation criterion"; the old version of this main thread was revised five times for exactly this.
常考「NaHCO₃ 析出说明它难溶吗」：不是，它仍是可溶盐（20 ℃ 9.6 g: Often tested "does NaHCO₃ precipitating mean it is insoluble": no, it's still a soluble salt (9.6 g/100 g water at 20 ℃); it just reaches supersaturation first in this process's solution.
20 ℃ 时 NaHCO₃ 的溶解度 9.6 g/100 g 水是四种里最小的；: At 20 ℃ NaHCO₃'s solubility of 9.6 g/100 g water is the lowest of the four, and in ammoniated brine it quickly becomes supersaturated; supersaturation is the criterion for precipitation, and the solubility ranking is only a qualitative guide.
既然温度越低越容易析出，为什么工业上还要控在 25~40 ℃？: If lower temperatures precipitate more easily, why does industry keep it at 25–40 ℃?
把碳化温度拖到 45 ℃，看析出率与产量: Drag the carbonation temperature to 45 ℃ and watch the precipitation rate and output
溶解度 11.1 → 13.5，析出率 32.6 % → 21.1 %，产量 2: Solubility 11.1 → 13.5, precipitation rate 32.6 % → 21.1 %, output 24.0 → 20.5 t/h; crystals at the bottom of the tower get smaller
析出率 = 0.85·(18.0 − S)/18.0（B2.1 算子 1，课件设: Precipitation rate = 0.85·(18.0 − S)/18.0 (B2.1 operator 1, lesson setting)
NaHCO₃ 的溶解度随温度上升：10 ℃ 8.1、30 ℃ 11.1、45 ℃: NaHCO₃ solubility rises with temperature: 8.1 at 10 ℃, 11.1 at 30 ℃, 13.5 g/100 g water at 45 ℃.
温度越高、过饱和度越小，析出率从 32.6 % 单调降到 21.1 %。: The higher the temperature, the lower the supersaturation, and the precipitation rate falls steadily from 32.6 % to 21.1 %.
温度太低反应又太慢（10 ℃ 只有 15.95 t/h），所以工业把碳化控在 2: Too low a temperature makes the reaction too slow (only 15.95 t/h at 10 ℃), so industry keeps carbonation at 25–40 ℃ with cooling to remove heat.
不控温：塔内一路升到 55 ℃，产量只剩 13.81 t/h（约额定的 58 %: Without temperature control the tower climbs to 55 ℃ and output falls to 13.81 t/h (about 58 % of rated).
常考「碳化温度为什么不能太高」：溶解度变大、过饱和变小，析出率下降；同时氨挥发增: Often tested "why carbonation temperature can't be too high": solubility rises and supersaturation falls, lowering the precipitation rate; ammonia volatilization also increases.
升温溶解度变大、过饱和变小，析出率单调下降；但温度太低动力学跟不上（10 ℃ 只: Raising the temperature increases solubility and lowers supersaturation, so the precipitation rate falls steadily; but too low a temperature slows the kinetics (only 15.95 t/h at 10 ℃), so industry uses 25–40 ℃ with cooling control.
A3 结论 3、A4、B1.2、B5.2 R2/R9: A3 conclusion 3, A4, B1.2, B5.2 R2/R9
塔底出来的晶浆，怎么变成两种东西？: How does the slurry from the bottom of the tower become two things?
点一下滤碱机，看晶浆分成哪两路: Click the bicarbonate filter and see which two streams the slurry splits into
滤碱机被选中，两条出料箭头亮起：重碱去煅烧、母液去冷析；产量仍是 24.0 t/: With the filter selected, two outlet arrows light up: crude bicarbonate to calcination, mother liquor to cooling crystallization; output is still 24.0 t/h, as filtration doesn't change the equilibrium
过滤不改变析出量，只分两路：重碱去煅烧、母液去冷析并循环: Filtration doesn't change the amount precipitated, it just splits two ways: crude bicarbonate to calcination, mother liquor to cooling and recycling
碳化塔底出来的是晶浆：NaHCO₃ 晶体悬浮在母液里。: What comes out of the bottom of the carbonation tower is slurry: NaHCO₃ crystals suspended in mother liquor.
转鼓真空过滤把固体（重碱）与液体（母液）分开，这一步不改变平衡、也不改变析出量。: The rotary vacuum filter separates the solid (crude bicarbonate) from the liquid (mother liquor); this step changes neither the equilibrium nor the amount precipitated.
两路各有去处：重碱去煅烧，母液去冷析结晶器捞 NH₄Cl，剩下的母液循环回氨化。: Each stream has its destination: crude bicarbonate to calcination, mother liquor to the cooling crystallizer to recover NH₄Cl, with the remaining liquor recycled to ammoniation.
去掉过滤：晶体混在母液里一起进煅烧炉，产品里混进 NH₄Cl 等杂质，纯碱不纯。: Skip filtration and the crystals go into the calciner mixed with mother liquor, so impurities such as NH₄Cl end up in the product and the soda ash is impure.
常考「过滤后母液去哪」：去冷析结晶器加盐降温析出 NH₄Cl，再循环回氨化，不排: Often tested "where does the mother liquor go after filtration": to the cooling crystallizer, where salt is added and it is cooled to precipitate NH₄Cl, then back to ammoniation; it isn't discharged.
过滤把重碱（去煅烧）与母液（去冷析结晶器）分开；母液处理后循环回氨化，这一步不改: Filtration separates crude bicarbonate (to calcination) from mother liquor (to the cooling crystallizer); after treatment the liquor is recycled to ammoniation, and this step doesn't change the amount precipitated.
重碱要烧到什么程度才是纯碱？: How far must crude bicarbonate be heated to become soda ash?
把煅烧温度从 200 ℃ 往下拖到 120 ℃，看分解率与产量: Drag the calcination temperature down from 200 ℃ to 120 ℃ and watch the decomposition rate and output
分解率 100 % → 33.3 %，产量 24.0 → 8.00 t/h；再拖: Decomposition 100 % → 33.3 %, output 24.0 → 8.00 t/h; at 100 ℃ output is 0
工业 160~230 ℃；本课模型 100 ℃ 为 0、160 ℃ 起 100: Industry 160–230 ℃; in this lesson's model, 0 at 100 ℃ and 100 % from 160 ℃ (piecewise rule)
煅烧让 NaHCO₃ 分解：2NaHCO₃ → Na₂CO₃ + H₂O + C: Calcination decomposes NaHCO₃: 2NaHCO₃ → Na₂CO₃ + H₂O + CO₂↑, and the CO₂ released is recovered and reused.
工业区间 160~230 ℃；本课模型里 100 ℃ 分解率为 0、160 ℃: The industrial range is 160–230 ℃; in this lesson's model decomposition is 0 at 100 ℃ and 100 % from 160 ℃ (a piecewise rule, not a measured boundary).
温度不够，产品里还是小苏打，产量只有 8.00 t/h（分解率 33.3 %）；: Not hot enough and the product is still baking soda, with output only 8.00 t/h (decomposition 33.3 %); too hot (> 320 ℃) and it sinters and the plant shuts down.
去掉煅烧：拿到的是小苏打而不是纯碱，CO₂ 也回不到碳化塔。: Skip calcination and you get baking soda instead of soda ash, and the CO₂ can't return to the carbonation tower.
常考「煅烧温度过低 / 过高的后果」：过低分解不完全、产品残留小苏打；过高物料熔: Often tested "consequences of calcination too cold / too hot": too cold, incomplete decomposition and baking soda left in the product; too hot, material sinters onto the walls and forces a shutdown.
2NaHCO₃ ─△→ Na₂CO₃ + CO₂↑ + H₂O，160 ℃ 以上: 2NaHCO₃ ─△→ Na₂CO₃ + CO₂↑ + H₂O, complete only above 160 ℃; too cold and the product is still baking soda, too hot (> 320 ℃) and it sinters and shuts down.
母液里剩下的东西，怎么变成氮肥？: How does what's left in the mother liquor become nitrogen fertilizer?
把冷析温度降到 10 ℃，并打开 CO₂ 回收: Lower the cooling temperature to 10 ℃ and turn on CO₂ recovery
结晶率 15.4 % → 44.0 %；打开回收后供给覆盖率 30 % → 62: Crystallization 15.4 % → 44.0 %; with recovery on, supply coverage 30 % → 62 %, output 17.3 → 24.0 t/h
加 NaCl 至饱和 + 降温到 10 ℃ 以下（同离子效应 → 过饱和，物理结: Add NaCl to saturation + cool below 10 ℃ (common-ion effect → supersaturation, physical crystallization)
母液里还剩下 NH₄Cl：加 NaCl 到饱和（同离子效应）再降到 10 ℃ 以: NH₄Cl remains in the mother liquor: add NaCl to saturation (common-ion effect) and cool below 10 ℃, and only then does it supersaturate and crystallize.
冷析温度越低结晶率越高：30 ℃ 15.4 %、20 ℃ 30.0 %、10 ℃: The lower the cooling temperature, the higher the crystallization rate: 15.4 % at 30 ℃, 30.0 % at 20 ℃, 44.0 % at 10 ℃.
析出的 NH₄Cl 是氮肥；煅烧回收的 CO₂ 与合成氨副产一起供碳化，供给覆盖: The NH₄Cl that precipitates is a nitrogen fertilizer; CO₂ recovered from calcination joins by-product CO₂ from ammonia synthesis to feed carbonation, with 62 % supply coverage, or only 30 % with recovery off.
不回收母液：NH₄Cl 随废液排掉，既浪费氮又污染水体——这正是侯氏法比氨碱法多: Without recovering the mother liquor, NH₄Cl goes out with the waste liquid, wasting nitrogen and polluting water; that's exactly the extra gain Hou's process has over the ammonia-soda process.
常考「母液为什么加盐又降温」「CO₂ 从哪来」：同离子效应 + 降温过饱和；CO: Often tested "why add salt to the mother liquor and cool it" and "where does the CO₂ come from": common-ion effect + cooling to supersaturate; CO₂ comes from ammonia-synthesis by-product and recovery from calcination.
母液加 NaCl 到饱和（同离子效应）再降到 10 ℃ 以下，NH₄Cl 才过饱: Add NaCl to the mother liquor to saturation (common-ion effect) and cool below 10 ℃, and NH₄Cl supersaturates and precipitates as nitrogen fertilizer; CO₂ recovered from calcination joins ammonia-synthesis by-product to feed carbonation: that's the "combined" part.
你来当班长：能不能让这一班稳稳达产？: You're the shift lead: can you get this shift steadily to target output?
在参照带内让纯碱产量 ≥ 22 t/h 并保持 15 s；中途会出一次碳化温度偏: Within the reference band, get soda ash output ≥ 22 t/h and hold for 15 s; partway through there will be one fault with carbonation temperature running high
达标横幅：纯碱 ≥ 22 t/h 保持 15 s（碳化 25~40 ℃、煅烧 1: Pass banner: soda ash ≥ 22 t/h held for 15 s (carbonation 25–40 ℃, calcination 160–230 ℃, cooling ≤ 15 ℃, ammonia absorption and recycling both on)
达标：纯碱 ≥ 22 t/h 保持 15 s；冷析判定放宽到 ≤ 15 ℃（fa: Pass: soda ash ≥ 22 t/h held for 15 s; the cooling criterion is relaxed to ≤ 15 ℃ (facts B2 setting, for easier operation)
达标要五段同时守住：吸氨开、碳化 25~40 ℃、煅烧 160~230 ℃、冷析: To pass, all five sections must hold at once: ammonia absorption on, carbonation 25–40 ℃, calcination 160–230 ℃, cooling ≤ 15 ℃ (relaxed to 15 ℃ in this lesson for easier operation, a setting), recycling on.
产量 = 析出率 × 碳化程度 × 循环 × 分解率，任何一项塌下来产量就掉一个: Output = precipitation rate × carbonation degree × recycling × decomposition rate; if any one collapses, output drops a level.
中途会出一次碳化温度偏高的异常，要自己拉回来，别让它拖过 15 s。: Partway through there will be one fault with carbonation temperature running high; bring it back yourself and don't let it drag past 15 s.
达产不是某一个旋钮的事：只调一个滑块拿不到 22 t/h。: Hitting target isn't about one knob: adjusting a single slider won't get 22 t/h.
综合考点：把「顺序、过饱和、分解、循环」四条串起来解释这一班为什么达产（或为什么: Synthesis: link "order, supersaturation, decomposition, recycling" to explain why this shift hit (or missed) target.
达产 = 每一段都守在区间里：顺序对了、温度对了、分解完全、母液和 CO₂ 都循: Hitting target = every section held within its range: correct order, correct temperatures, complete decomposition, and both mother liquor and CO₂ recycled.
煅烧 > 320 ℃ 才会熔结停车: Calcination only sinters and shuts down above 320 ℃
让纯碱产量 ≥ 22 t/h 并保持 15 s（碳化 25~40 ℃、煅烧 16: Get soda ash output ≥ 22 t/h and hold for 15 s (carbonation 25–40 ℃, calcination 160–230 ℃, cooling ≤ 15 ℃, ammonia absorption and recycling on)
吸氨中断：氨盐水里没有 NH₃，CO₂ 吸收不住，析出率只剩 2 %: Ammonia absorption interrupted: no NH₃ in the brine, CO₂ isn't retained, precipitation rate only 2 %
吸氨恢复：溶液重新显碱性，CO₂ 吸收与析出回到正常: Ammonia absorption restored: the solution is basic again and CO₂ absorption and precipitation return to normal
CO₂ 回收投用：煅烧气回到碳化，供给覆盖率 62 %: CO₂ recovery on: calcination gas returns to carbonation, supply coverage 62 %
CO₂ 回收停用：只剩合成氨副产，供给覆盖率 30 %: CO₂ recovery off: only ammonia-synthesis by-product left, supply coverage 30 %
异常：碳化温度被拉到 41 ℃，产量要掉——把它拉回 25~40 ℃: Fault: carbonation temperature pushed to 41 ℃ and output will drop; bring it back to 25–40 ℃
侯氏制碱为什么先把盐水变成氨盐水，再通 CO₂？: Why does Hou's process turn brine into ammoniated brine before passing in CO₂?
氨水显碱性，CO₂ 吸收量大增并以 HCO₃⁻ 存在: Ammonia water is basic, so CO₂ absorption increases greatly and it exists as HCO₃⁻
NH₃ 能把 NaCl 直接变成 NaHCO₃: NH₃ can turn NaCl directly into NaHCO₃
为了把盐水里的钙镁离子沉淀掉: To precipitate calcium and magnesium ions from the brine
为了让溶液降温、便于析出: To cool the solution and help precipitation
NH₃ 使溶液显碱性，CO₂ 被大量吸收并以 HCO₃⁻ 形式存在，NaHCO₃: NH₃ makes the solution basic so CO₂ is absorbed in large amounts as HCO₃⁻, and only then can NaHCO₃ supersaturate and precipitate (A4, A5.2).
侯氏法比氨碱法革除了哪两步？: Which two steps did Hou's process eliminate from the ammonia-soda process?
侯氏法不用石灰窑取 CO₂、也不用石灰乳蒸氨，因此不产生含 CaCl₂ 的蒸氨废: Hou's process needs no lime kiln for CO₂ and no lime milk to distill ammonia, so it produces no CaCl₂-containing distillation waste (A2.2).
碳化塔里气液为什么逆流（CO₂ 从塔底上、氨盐水从塔顶下）？: Why do gas and liquid flow countercurrent in the carbonation tower (CO₂ up from the bottom, ammoniated brine down from the top)?
浓度差最大，CO₂ 吸收更充分: The concentration difference is largest, so CO₂ is absorbed more fully
为了让 NaHCO₃ 溶解度变小: To reduce the solubility of NaHCO₃
逆流接触时气相与液相的浓度差最大，吸收推动力最大（A5.1）。: In countercurrent contact the concentration difference between gas and liquid is largest, giving the greatest driving force for absorption (A5.1).
碳化后 NaHCO₃ 为什么会析出？: Why does NaHCO₃ precipitate after carbonation?
在实际氨盐水里达到过饱和: It becomes supersaturated in the actual ammoniated brine
因为它完全难溶于水: Because it is completely insoluble in water
因为它和 NH₄Cl 生成了沉淀: Because it forms a precipitate with NH₄Cl
判据是过饱和；同温度下它溶解度绝对值最小只作定性参考（A3 结论 1、A7-E2: The criterion is supersaturation; having the lowest absolute solubility at the same temperature is only a qualitative guide (A3 conclusion 1, A7-E2/E13).
20 ℃ 时四种物质在水里的溶解度最小的是？: At 20 ℃, which of the four substances has the lowest solubility in water?
数据表 A3：20 ℃ 时 NaHCO₃ 9.6 g/100 g 水，四种里最小: Data table A3: at 20 ℃ NaHCO₃ is 9.6 g/100 g water, the lowest of the four.
过滤之后母液去哪？: Where does the mother liquor go after filtration?
去冷析结晶器加盐降温析出 NH₄Cl，再循环回氨化: To the cooling crystallizer, where salt is added and it is cooled to precipitate NH₄Cl, then recycled to ammoniation
回到碳化塔继续通 CO₂: Back to the carbonation tower for more CO₂
去煅烧炉烧掉: To the calciner to be burned off
母液加 NaCl 到饱和再降温，析出可作氮肥的 NH₄Cl，母液循环使用（A4、: NaCl is added to the mother liquor to saturation and it is cooled, precipitating NH₄Cl usable as nitrogen fertilizer; the liquor is recycled (A4, A5.3, A7-E10).
煅烧温度过低会怎样？: What happens if the calcination temperature is too low?
NaHCO₃ 分解不完全，产品残留小苏打: NaHCO₃ decomposes incompletely, leaving baking soda in the product
纯碱分解成小苏打: Soda ash decomposes into baking soda
炉内物料熔结粘壁: Material sinters onto the furnace walls
160 ℃ 以上才分解完全；温度太低分解不完全，产品里还是小苏打（A4、A7-E: Decomposition is complete only above 160 ℃; too low and it's incomplete, leaving baking soda in the product (A4, A7-E8).
下列说法中，哪一条不是侯氏法的优点？: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of Hou's process?
用氨量比氨碱法少: It uses less ammonia than the ammonia-soda process
副产 NH₄Cl 氮肥: It yields NH₄Cl nitrogen fertilizer as a by-product
不再产生含 CaCl₂ 的蒸氨废液: It no longer produces CaCl₂-containing distillation waste
侯氏法用氨量其实更大（氮进了 NH₄Cl 产品，但氨的总投入更多），有些情况下不: Hou's process actually uses more ammonia (the nitrogen goes into the NH₄Cl product, but total ammonia input is larger), and in some situations it isn't suitable (A7-E4).
煅烧炉超温熔结 · 停车清炉: Calciner overheating and sintering · shutdown to clean the furnace
操作员为压住「分解率不够」的报警而持续提温: The operator keeps raising the temperature to silence the "decomposition too low" alarm
越过 320 ℃，炉内局部物料熔结成块、粘在扬料板上: Past 320 ℃, material in parts of the furnace sinters into lumps and sticks to the lifter flights
传热恶化、筒体局部超温变形，传动电流超限跳闸: Heat transfer worsens, the shell overheats and deforms locally, and the drive current trips
停车清炉：敲掉结块、检查炉衬后才能重启（本课虚构情境）: Shutdown to clean the furnace: knock off the lumps and inspect the lining before restarting (fictional scenario for this lesson)
温度联锁：超过工业区间上限就自动降负荷、切断燃料，而不是靠人盯表。: Temperature interlock: above the industrial upper limit, automatically cut load and fuel, rather than relying on someone watching the gauge.
均匀加热、控制物料停留时间，避免局部过热。: Heat evenly and control residence time to avoid local overheating.
定期清炉、检查炉衬，把结块清在变成事故之前。: Clean the furnace and inspect the lining regularly, clearing lumps before they become an accident.
温度是手段不是目的：分解率到 100 % 就够了，再多给的热量只会烧设备。: Temperature is the means, not the goal: 100 % decomposition is enough, and extra heat only burns the equipment.
八个步骤：从盐到碱的物料流 → 先氨后碳 → 过饱和析出 → 碳化温度 → 过滤: Eight steps: material flow from salt to soda → ammonia before CO₂ → supersaturated precipitation → carbonation temperature → filtering into two → calcining to soda → recycling of mother liquor and CO₂ → you're the shift lead.
